scope: A full prerequisite-led curriculum specification. It does not claim implemented training, biological validation, positional value or reasoning.

prerequisites.name: Learning, retention and reversal handshake
requires: verified released neuron identities and supported anatomical eligibility
balanced independently checkable synthetic-contingency assay, separate from chess truth
association, interference retention and reversal in each of three distinct computational replicas
direction and output specificity against absent, matched-shuffled and disabled controls
exact reset/restoration and interrupted pending-frame recovery

datasets.disjointBy: structural family, causal relation composition and board/history identities; built-in symmetry equivalents remain in the same split
datasets.finalReadPolicy: sealed until checkpoint selection; one primary evaluation only
datasets.unknownFinalPolicy: invalid audit; no advancement, no silent replacement or denominator reduction

training.replicaContract: Different frozen public-input projection seeds must actually change evoked neural responses. Identical unused-head seeds do not count as independent replicas.
training.checkpointSelection: earliest checkpoint passing every validation criterion and earlier-principle retention; controls use the same block index
training.targetSelection: informative arm's freshly reassessed training errors only; controls replay the complete identical experience schedule
training.unknownPolicy: no event; log and stop the frozen block rather than silently drop it
training.shuffledContract: Freeze permutation algorithm/seed before informative execution; construct yoked schedule before control replay. Preserve action/task/actor exposure, success/failure pulse totals and timing; break context-outcome contingency. Reject unbalanced strata.
training.assessmentContract: Current TemporalFeedbackSession requires all-legal pre-teaching binding. Selective-decision plus separate diagnostic binding needs a new reviewed interface; do not bypass the existing assertion.
training.memory: one continuous from-scratch lineage per condition/replica; accepted stage checkpoints continue; no per-lesson reinitialization

D3.metric: final unaided all-legal useful choices, every replica

D4.metric: final consequence sign predictions on two certified probe actions per board

D6.metric: final useful-choice advantage over scratch and each matched control
D6.confidence: 95 percent paired family-cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20261011; require positive lower bound for each comparison; report replica results separately

D7.metric: retention after 8 additional four-event blocks and after every later stage
D7.scope: computational interference retention, not biological elapsed-time retention

requires: remove latest-stage learned memory and lose acquired advantage
restore selected memory and recover identical predictions/rankings
independent certificate and local update replay
exact pending-receipt recovery with no duplicated update
unaided and fixed-budget search reported separately

extendedPosition.scope: calibration to pinned engine estimates, not true win probability

integratedPlay.unknownStoppedGamePolicy: incomplete evaluation; do not label an unfinished game a draw
integratedPlay.scope: frozen mini-position/reference-policy pool, not Elo or general human-level strength

F0.name: Certificate-bound root association
F0.learnerReceives: public root board/action/task cue and bounded experimental PPL103 stimulus timing; never certificate text or a safe/unsafe input flag
F0.memory: RateTimingMemory eligible KC-to-MBON gains plus kcTrace/short/long; fixed graph signs/topology

F1.name: Verified sequence/root-credit learning
F1.learnerReceives: bounded public transition frames and a declared outcome code; certificate scope, earlier choice binding and illustrative branch remain teacher-side
F1.requires: independent root and selected earlier-choice proofs, causal root-cue/credit ablation, matched root-only F0 comparator, validated within-budget credit timing

F2.name: Additional positional value-error teaching
F2.prediction: Candidate-free position cue -> fixed reference-relative MBON ensemble contrast z -> p_child=(1+tanh(z))/2; orient to root actor as 1-p_child when the child side to move is the opponent. This is an uncalibrated candidate until gates pass; max over action preferences is not a position-value implementation.
F2.target: exact child board/history; actor-oriented (W + D/2)/1000 from pinned Stockfish estimates
F2.error: Child-side target minus child-side frozen prediction for delivery. Root-actor target/prediction/error are also recorded, with complement/sign conversion when child turn is opponent.
F2.delivery: additional current 1.5*abs(error), clipped to 1.5, through a newly preregistered timing/pathway interface; sign must pass G0 direction/retention/reversal at graded doses

F3.name: Independently replayed actual episode outcomes
F3.learnerReceives: public actual trajectory plus declared terminal teaching; sampled opponent outcomes are not best-defense proofs
F3.terminal: verified legal checkmate/draw rules on complete history; max80-plies unfinished episode is unknown
F3.credit: earlier choice attribution needs certified counterfactual replay under a pinned reference policy and the episode-credit prerequisite

capture-retention.scope: Existing verifier accepts captures only. Full-action task version must independently certify legal noncaptures as failure to perform the declared capture task, without calling them globally bad moves.

forced-mate.scope: attacker OR / defender AND complete bounded mate consequence

bounded-material.scope: guarantee declared net nominal material delta by horizon while avoiding certified own checkmate; draws and terminal precedence are specified in the curriculum

avoid-loss.scope: guarantee no own checkmate and material loss above declared tolerance through all required opponent replies

promotion.scope: force declared pawn promotion by horizon under legal defensive replies; no assumption promotion wins

position-estimate.scope: pinned multi-budget Stockfish child-position target; never a consequence certificate

played-outcome.scope: actual legal terminal episode under declared reference policy; not unsampled best defense

resources.deadlines: soft across uninterruptible evaluator calls; memory guards between calls

lessons.definition: Whether an opponent can legally recapture the moved capturing piece depends on defenders, blockers and king constraints.
lessons.target: Predict immediate recapturability and prefer retention when retention is the declared task.
lessons.positive: Same capture survives every legal immediate reply because the defender is absent, its line is blocked, or an apparent defender is pinned and cannot legally recapture.
lessons.negative: The otherwise similar capture allows a legal recapture by an available, unblocked and unpinned defender.
lessons.counterfactual: Change one blocker or defender while retaining the capture identity and material, reversing recapturability.
lessons.opponent: Enumerate the exact legal next replies; distinguish an available recapture from an obligation to recapture.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 on each of four strata: open defender, blocked defender, absent defender, pinned apparent defender; never interpret retention as universal move quality.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 on each of four strata: open defender, blocked defender, absent defender, pinned apparent defender; never interpret retention as universal move quality.

lessons.definition: Check restricts legal replies; mate requires that no legal escape remains. A useful defense prevents a verified impending consequence.
lessons.target: Distinguish check from mate and select a defense when a quiet improvement permits mate.
lessons.positive: Certified mate-in-one, or a legal defensive move preventing every opponent mating continuation within the declared horizon.
lessons.negative: A check has a quiet blocking/escaping defense; an attractive nondefensive move permits a certified mating reply.
lessons.counterfactual: Change one escape square, supporting piece or interposition route so the same check or defense changes outcome.
lessons.opponent: Include king escapes, captures of the checker, interpositions and quiet mating threats.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 in each stratum: actual mate, escapable check, mandatory defense, misleading improving move; all success claims cover every required escape.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 in each stratum: actual mate, escapable check, mandatory defense, misleading improving move; all success claims cover every required escape.

lessons.principle: Sound forcing moves and reply awareness
lessons.definition: Checks, captures and threats are investigation priorities; soundness depends on what an opponent can force in response.
lessons.target: Select a useful forcing candidate when one exists, and reject tempting forcing candidates refuted by forcing or quiet defense.
lessons.positive: A check, capture or threat meets the fixed mate/material criterion against all required defenses.
lessons.negative: A high-priority check loses the payoff, an apparently profitable capture is refuted, or a threat can be neutralized quietly.
lessons.counterfactual: Preserve the surface forcing move while adding or removing a specific defensive resource.
lessons.opponent: Include counterchecks, recaptures, queen trades and quiet refutations. Do not filter opponent moves to only forcing tags.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 in each stratum: sound check, sound capture/threat, forcing refutation, quiet refutation; no check-priority score may supply the final answer.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 in each stratum: sound check, sound capture/threat, forcing refutation, quiet refutation; no check-priority score may supply the final answer.

lessons.definition: Multiple targets matter only when the opponent cannot neutralize the consequences together; geometric double attacks alone do not prove a gain.
lessons.target: Use forks and overworked defenders to obtain a guaranteed bounded payoff, while rejecting apparent forks that can be parried.
lessons.positive: The opponent's legal defenses cannot save both relevant outcomes, producing a certified material gain or mate.
lessons.negative: One reply trades the attacker, checks our king, or otherwise neutralizes both apparent threats.
lessons.counterfactual: Add one defensive option or remove an overloaded duty so the double threat no longer wins.
lessons.opponent: Look for combined defenses and counterattacks, not merely retreating one target.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 separately for real forks, apparent forks, overloaded defenders and defensive counterattacks; a count of attacked pieces cannot pass.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 separately for real forks, apparent forks, overloaded defenders and defensive counterattacks; a count of attacked pieces cannot pass.

lessons.principle: Lines, blockers and removal of defenders
lessons.definition: Changing a blocker or defender changes which attacks and defensive resources are available.
lessons.target: Choose a line-opening or defender-removing action because of its verified resulting consequence.
lessons.positive: Opening a ray, a discovered attack, or removing a defender permits a certified payoff.
lessons.negative: A remaining blocker, a second defender or an exposed own king prevents the same-looking plan.
lessons.counterfactual: Move one blocker or substitute a defensive resource while preserving the candidate's local appearance.
lessons.opponent: Include interposition, replacement defense, countercheck and recapture after defender removal.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for opening a line, discovered attack, defender removal and replacement defense; removal of a piece is not sufficient evidence of causal usefulness.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for opening a line, discovered attack, defender removal and replacement defense; removal of a piece is not sufficient evidence of causal usefulness.

lessons.principle: Move order, intermediate moves and sacrifices
lessons.definition: An earlier concession can enable a later consequence; changing move order or support can invalidate it.
lessons.target: Prefer a necessary intermediate move or supported sacrifice when its full declared consequence succeeds, and reject its unsound counterpart.
lessons.positive: A certified sequence requires the preparatory action or concession before the payoff against all required replies.
lessons.negative: Direct execution fails, an opponent intermediate move refutes the concession, or the later compensation is unavailable.
lessons.counterfactual: Remove payoff support or change move order so the same concession fails at the same horizon.
lessons.opponent: Search intermediate checks, declined sacrifices and defensive alternatives; accepting a sacrifice is not assumed.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for necessary preparation, sound concession, unsound concession and opponent intermediate move. Credit root and later choices only with independent state/action certificates.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for necessary preparation, sound concession, unsound concession and opponent intermediate move. Credit root and later choices only with independent state/action certificates.

lessons.principle: Piece effectiveness and improving an ineffective piece
lessons.definition: A piece is useful through its contextual attacking or defensive role, not simply its number of moves or nominal value.
lessons.target: Activate a constrained piece, sometimes by moving a blocker or preparing a route, while preserving important duties.
lessons.positive: A quiet action improves participation and enables a certified later payoff; alternative high-mobility moves do not.
lessons.negative: A mobility increase has no useful consequence, abandons defense, or activates the wrong piece for the position.
lessons.counterfactual: Change the relevant target or defensive duty so the same activation ceases to help.
lessons.opponent: Include a timely attack on the abandoned duty and interference with the intended route.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for freeing a blocker, rerouting a piece, useless mobility and abandoned duty; include successful actions by a piece other than the ineffective piece.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for freeing a blocker, rerouting a piece, useless mobility and abandoned duty; include successful actions by a piece other than the ineffective piece.

lessons.definition: Pieces can enable one another's consequences by support, access and complementary duties; redundant attacks need not improve the position.
lessons.target: Develop coordinated participation rather than independently maximize each piece's activity.
lessons.positive: Preparing support or access lets multiple pieces complete a certified consequence without losing an essential duty.
lessons.negative: Redundant participation adds nothing, a support piece is removable, or coordination is achieved at the cost of an urgent defense.
lessons.counterfactual: Remove one supporting relationship or change its legal availability so the coordinated plan fails.
lessons.opponent: Include exchanges of supporters, interference and exploitation of overloaded own defenders.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for shared targets, support preparation, interference and redundant/unsafe coordination; supply paired support interventions, not only co-occurring activity.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for shared targets, support preparation, interference and redundant/unsafe coordination; supply paired support interventions, not only co-occurring activity.

lessons.principle: Weaknesses, pawn structure and weak squares
lessons.definition: A weakness is exploitable in context through available routes, targets and timing; structural labels alone do not determine value.
lessons.target: Repair, defend, compensate for or exploit a weakness based on consequences, including exceptions to textbook structural preferences.
lessons.positive: A defense or pressure plan changes a certified material/mating consequence, or improves the separately measured value target.
lessons.negative: Repairing a pawn structure permits a greater loss; an isolated/doubled pawn is unexploitable or compensated by activity.
lessons.counterfactual: Change access to the weak square or supporting route while leaving the superficial pawn classification unchanged.
lessons.opponent: Include pawn breaks, exchanges of attackers and switching pressure to another target.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for repair, exploitation, compensation and unexploitable apparent weakness; the extended positional value gate is required in addition to bounded task gates.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for repair, exploitation, compensation and unexploitable apparent weakness; the extended positional value gate is required in addition to bounded task gates.

lessons.principle: Restriction, prophylaxis and the opponent's plan
lessons.definition: A move can be useful by preventing a consequential opponent plan even without an immediate attacking gain.
lessons.target: Choose timely prevention when an opponent's verified threat outranks a tempting own improvement, and avoid unnecessary passive prevention.
lessons.positive: A quiet restraining action denies an otherwise certified opponent payoff and preserves our counterplay.
lessons.negative: An improving move ignores the threat, or prophylaxis addresses a nonexistent threat and permits a stronger opponent plan.
lessons.counterfactual: Remove the opponent plan's prerequisite so the preventative move becomes unnecessary or wrong.
lessons.opponent: Model future pawn breaks, activation routes, exchanges and quiet preparation in the actual legal child positions.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for preventing a break, restricting a piece, unnecessary prophylaxis and competing threats; include changed-plan pairs where the preferred response reverses.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for preventing a break, restricting a piece, unnecessary prophylaxis and competing threats; include changed-plan pairs where the preferred response reverses.

lessons.principle: Pawn breaks, exchanges and endgame transitions
lessons.definition: Irreversible changes alter access, king roles, pawn prospects and the value of preserving or exchanging pieces.
lessons.target: Compare preparing a pawn break, trading into an ending and preserving tension according to the resulting consequences.
lessons.positive: A prepared break, an appropriate exchange or king activation enables certified promotion/material/mate or a better declared position target.
lessons.negative: The same exchange causes a draw or exposes the king; an unprepared break creates a decisive weakness; nominal simplification loses the useful plan.
lessons.counterfactual: Change king activity, pawn support or an exchange partner so the same transition changes outcome.
lessons.opponent: Include blockade, counterbreak, refusal of an exchange and promotion races.
lessons.done: At least 12/16 for prepared breaks, premature breaks, exchanges and king/pawn endings; favorable endgame labels require exact bounded evidence or an explicitly labeled estimate.

definitionOfDone.specialization: At least 12/16 for prepared breaks, premature breaks, exchanges and king/pawn endings; favorable endgame labels require exact bounded evidence or an explicitly labeled estimate.

lessons.principle: Compositional plans and selective adversarial investigation
lessons.definition: Reusable relationships must be combined and revised in unfamiliar positions while both players pursue their own consequences.
lessons.target: Select forcing or positional candidates, examine opposing refutations, combine learned relationships and abandon plans when their premises fail.
lessons.positive: A held-out combination of mastered relationships yields a useful choice and a robust continuation under a fixed investigation budget.
lessons.negative: A familiar-looking combination has a quiet refutation, or a memorized plan persists after its enabling relationship changes.
lessons.counterfactual: Hold most of the plan constant while altering one learned prerequisite, reversing the appropriate action or plan.
lessons.opponent: At every simulated ply retain forcing counterplay, necessary defense and quiet counterplans; widen unresolved candidate sets within the fixed budget.
lessons.done: Pass all component strata and the integrated value/whole-episode gates; final combinations are absent from training, no lesson/motif answer tags reach the policy, and no engine query enters the learner evaluation function.

definitionOfDone.specialization: Pass all component strata and the integrated value/whole-episode gates; final combinations are absent from training, no lesson/motif answer tags reach the policy, and no engine query enters the learner evaluation function.
